name: civswitch-payload-menu
description: CivHomebrew: an on-device payload library for CivSwitch

scripts.pack:hello: python3 -B -c "from tools.civapps_native_ui import verify; verify('.'); verify('examples/hello')" && python3 -B tools/package_payload.py --directory examples/hello --non-interactive --no-save-metadata -o dist/hello.civapp
scripts.test: node --test tests/core.cjs tests/updates.cjs tests/system-updates.cjs tests/legacy.cjs tests/native-read.cjs tests/system.cjs tests/resident.cjs tests/keyboard.cjs tests/boot-install.cjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.pack:kit: python3 -B tools/package_payload.py --directory examples/civswitch-kit --non-interactive -o dist/civswitch-kit-checks.civapp && python3 -B tools/package_payload.py --inspect dist/civswitch-kit-checks.civapp
